## Our sponsors

### Australian Bureau of Statistics

![<https://www.abs.gov.au/>](img/abs.png){height=150px fig-align="left"}

The Australian Bureau of Statistics are providing the perfect venue for this year's conference, hosting us in the heart of the organisation at ABS House in Belconnen.

### Statistical Society of Australia

![<https://statsoc.org.au/>](img/ssa.png){height=150px fig-align="left"}

The Statistical Society of Australia is the peak professional body for statisticians and data scientists in Australia. With branches across the country and a data science special interest group, visit their website to find out how to join and what's happening near you.

## Sponsorship packages

By sponsoring the conference you'll have a unique opportunity access Australia's top data scientists as well as graduates entering the job market. To find out more or discuss a custom sponsorship arrangement, get in touch with the conference chair, [Ben Harrap](mailto:benjamin.harrap@anu.edu.au?subject=ADSN Conference Sponsorship).

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
library(gt)
library(readr)
read_csv("resources/sponsorship.csv") |> 
  gt() |> 
  sub_missing(
    columns = everything(),
    rows = everything(),
    missing_text = ""
    ) |>
  opt_row_striping(row_striping = FALSE) |>
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(16)
  ) |>
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = -Benefits) |> 
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold", size = px(17)),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  )
```
